tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /myur mdzad mgon po phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs

tshigs bcad ma bzhugs/ oṃ swā sti/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis/ /pad nyi gaṃ las tshogs bdag dkar/ /glang gdong la phug ne'u le bsnams/ kha sbub dar dang nor bus brgyan/ /de steng hūṃ las gri gug las/ /myur mdzad mgon po phyag drug pa/ /nag po sbyan gsum mche ba gtsigs/ /gri gug mgo 'phreng ḍa ru g.yas/ /thod khrag rtse gsum zhags pa g.yon/ /mgo 'phreng sin+dhu thig le dang*/ /stag lpags rgyan drug g.yer kha sbrul/ /dbu skra gyen brdzes mi bskyod brgyan/ /mnyam pa'i stabs can me dpung nang*/ /dur khrod dbus na shing drung bzhugs/ khrag mtsho bh+yoḥlas re ma ti/ /sngo nag ral gri thod khrag 'dzin/ /rab khros dre'u rta rkang gsum bcibs/ /k+ṣaṃ las k+ṣe ṭa pa la nag /gri thod 'dzin cing dom nag bzhon/ /hūṃ las dzi na mi tra smug /srin po cang te'u thod khrag 'dzin/ / ṭaṃ las gshin rje 'dod rgyal nag /lcags kyu zhags pa sdigs mdzub mdzad/ / hūṃ las trak+shad rta nag chibs/ /mdung dmar thod pa 'jol ber can/ /sag lham gyon zhing bdud dmag bcas/ /phyogs skyong lha klu gza' 'jigs byed/ /rgyu skar rgyal chen dam can bcas/ /rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ shar lho dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal/ tsan+dan gyi shing rkang gcig pa'i drung nas/ ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa/ steng na rtsa rgyud bla ma dang*/ g.yas na dpa' bo'i ngar bcas shing*/ g.yon na dpa' mo'i 'dzum dang bcas pa/ 'khor dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs dang bcas pa/ oṃ badz+ra mahā kā la sa pa ri wa ra k+ṣiṃ/ dad pa dang ni sogs/ dam can rgya mtsho gshegs su gsol/ /bla ma dbang rgyal nor bu dril bu bsnams/ /'od zer snol mas dbyer med byin gyis brlabs/ /chos sku rdo rje 'chang chen po la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor la= rmog lcog pa rin chen brtson 'grus la= dbon ston skye sgang pa chen po la=

gnyan ston sbas pa'i sangs rgyas la= 'gro mgon sangs rgyas ston pa= mkhas grub gtsang ma shing ston= sogs <spar ma dang 'dra'o/ /> grub chen lha dbang grags pa la= drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la= bla ma mgon po dbyer med la= mgon po bla ma dbyer med la gsol ba 'debs/ /bla ma grub chen rdo rje thod pa bsnams/ /sangs rgyas sras bcas bkugs shing gnas gsum gyis/ /yig brgyas nyams sel bdag la byin gyis rlabs/ / yig brgya bzla/ na mo bung+ngha ya/ sogs/ mi/ kyai/ phyogs bcu dus gsum na bzhugs pa'i rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi byin gyis rlobs shig /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi= yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis= dpa' po dang dpa' mo rnal 'byor dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis= dpal ye shes kyi mgon po= sogs/ spar ma 'dra/ khyed rnams kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las mi bzad pa'i sgo nas byin gyis rlobs shig /da lta nyid du myur ba nyid 'dug sa 'di nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig /rdo rje 'chang dang dpal ldan shā ba ri/ / sogs/ rab tu bshags pas bde chen thob gyur cig /bla ma dbang sdud ḍā dril sin+dhur bskul// hrīḥlas yi ge'i lha mo bcu gsum bskor/ /oṃ badz+ra nā ra kriṃ kriṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ lan bdun/ de nas bzlas pa bya ste/ oṃ badz+ra mahā kā la kīṃ k+ṣe tra bigh+nan bi na ya ka hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭaḥswāhā/ snying po/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la sha sa na= sogs de na mi ke na mā ra ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ bh+yoḥm mo nag mo= oṃ k+ṣe tra pa la= oṃ dzi na mi tra= oṃ ṭak+ki ra dza= oṃ du yag dza= gtor ma la/ a mri ta sa bsangs/ swā bha wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung dang*/ raṃ las me/ a las ka pā lar/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga zhu bdud rtsir gyur/ ye shes bdud rtsi bkug bstim rgya mtshor gyur/ dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag ngo bo blta'o/

/oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hriḥ.oṃ badz+ra mahā ka la k+ṣiṃ k+ṣe tra bigh+na na bi na ya ka hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa i daṃ ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ badz+ra ma ha ka la k+ṣiṃ k+ṣe tra bigh+na na bi na ya ka dra ka rag mo ba ling ta maṃ sa rak+ta ru ti ra kha kha khā hi khā hi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ lan bdun nam lnga/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ hūṃ/ myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / nas/ ci 'dod dngos grub myur du stsal du gsol/ / ༈ gnod sbyin chen po la gtor bsngo ni/ oṃ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swā bha wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang la yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ a las ye shes kyi kā pa la yangs shing rgya che'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha hoḥhriḥ oṃ k+ṣe tra pa la bigh+nan hūṃ phaṭa/ e dam ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gnod sbyin chen po k+ṣe tra pa la 'khor dang bcas pas/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rje btsun kun dga' snying po'i bka' bsgos dam la bzhag pa ltar/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad srungs/ mthun rkyen yid la bsam pa'i don thams cad sgrub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes 'dod don gsol/ zhes pa'ang tā ra na thas brag stod rdo rje'i pho brang du bris pa'o// // sarba maṃ ga laṃ// bkra shis// 'di bris dge bas bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyis rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/tā ra nā tha'i gsung thor bu'i skor/ - PAGE 156 -- PAGE 155 -- PAGE 153 -
